newsitem.title: UK: U.S. stocks in London mixed in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks in London mixed in quiet trade.

text.p: U.S. stocks were mostly trading around their closing levels in London on Thursday, anticipating a mixed opening for the Dow following modest gains overnight.
"Things have quietened down a lot," said one trader. "We're looking for a mixed opening in the States and then it's anybody's guess," he added.
U.S. stocks ended moderately higher on Wednesday as optimism over interest rates and strong corporate earnings continued to lift sentiment. The Dow closed up 26.71 at a record 8,088.36.
Weekly jobless claims due at 1230 GMT could help set direction at the start today.

Among share features in London, Digital Equipment Corp rose on the expectation of favourable fourth quarter earnings on Thursday. Analysts were expecting earnings of $0.73 per share. The stock was $1/8 better at $40-1/8.

Shares in Eli Lilly and Co, which reported second quarter earnings on Wednesday, continued to benefit from positive comment and hopes for its new drug application Evista. The stock put on $1/2 to $116-1/2.
Philip Morris shares slipped, after a Florida court upheld a ruling allowing the state to use documents obtained from Brooke Group's Liggett in its lawsuit against the industry.
Elsewhere, Anheuser-Busch Co fell $1/4 to $45, after the company said full-year earnings growth would fall slightly below long-term objectives because of heavy discounting in the beer industry.
Dealers said shares in DuPont were also well bid on continuing positive sentiment after sharp gains in New York followed a 14 percent surge in second quarter net income.
